items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: But that's where Lewis used to get off the boat and come catch me playing there all the time to sit in and play with me.

ctx.x: Well, someplace I read you were, you played with Fate Narrable too. Did you play on the play?

Oh yeah, yeah, yeah. I played Vindoon with Fate a couple of Sundays after Lewis left, Chicago went to New York. Yeah. Well, they hired me and I taken Lewis place. And worked with him. Another funny thing about that.
